clips.text: So why can one in ten thousand people live with a heart on the right side and never know?
A stethoscope on the left chest heard almost nothing.
Move it to the right, and the heartbeat thumped in loud and clear.
The scan showed the organs mirrored, yet the man had lived an ordinary life.
Then pain low on the left made the emergency team redraw the map.
So why can one in ten thousand people live with a heart on the right side and never know?
The mirror is perfect, so everything still connects — and the flip began with a current before birth. Tap the video link under my name.
